complete_object_review.qualification: All complete consumer code/relocations and sections excluding .debug* and .chks64 match after explicit private-name handling. Full indices retain all excluded section bytes and relocations; their equality is not claimed. Four lambda tags are paired bijectively using unchanged parent function bytes at the same four relocation offsets, then every complete paired body/relocation is checked. Raw indices retain all names.
